Title: Data Folder Project Wiki Policy
Content: The repository Data/Memories folder is the structured project memory wiki for MemorySmith itself. Application defaults should continue pointing MemorySmith:DataPath to ../Data/Memories. Data/Pages is the markdown wiki for longer notes, design docs, roadmaps, future tasks, and council reviews. Memories should describe actual current state, durable facts, rules, and implemented behavior; future plans belong in pages rather than memory records. Tests that need real project memory data should copy Data/Memories into a temp directory and exercise the copy, so the source wiki remains stable while still acting as the application testbase. Purpose-built records tagged test-fixture provide deterministic search and context-pack graph cases without relying only on incidental product documentation.
